verified.analysis:
The event is real, dated and forward: Form 10 filed 2026-09-15, a signed $2.0B GC/Koch convertible preferred at $37.5B Axiom EV on 2026-10-05, and a Q1 CY2027 spin target. FLEX has fallen from about $117 to $87 since then, so the market now values all of Flex below the private mark on Axiom alone; that undoes the triage's 'mid-arc / priced' premise. My SoP, re-derived from the 9/25/26 balance sheet rather than taken from analyst targets (about 369M shares, $5.98B debt incl. leases, $3.08B cash, no pref on Flex's books yet so the deal had not closed by quarter-end): Axiom $37.5B less the $2.0B pref claim is about $96/sh. RemainCo (Agility+Reliability, about $1.0-1.2B EBIT at 10-12x, less about $3.7B net debt+leases) adds about $19-30/sh, for roughly $115-126 face, or about $95 with a 25% haircut on the private mark. That is +10% to +45% from $86.77.

GAPS (web-search budget exhausted, 10-Q text not read): not verified are the pref liquidation preference, dividend/PIK rate and conversion terms; whether the $2B proceeds stay at Axiom or go up to Flex; and how the $5.2B of long-term debt will be split. Convertible prefs priced at a headline EV usually carry downside protection that inflates that EV for the common, so I cap the score at 6 / WATCH rather than ACTIVE until the Form 10/A waterfall is read.
